market: • Our fair price: Dom Mar Fan is a 62% shot to win (fair odds -163).
• BetRivers pays -156, about 1.6% more than that.
• Only BetRivers has this price, so it may not last.

points: Mar Fan has a 5-inch reach edge and a more well-rounded game. Motta is a one-dimensional boxer who shows little grappling.
Motta is 33 and returns after a 17-month layoff, so timing and cardio past round one are real concerns.
Mar Fan lands 56% of his significant strikes to Motta's 38%, and he's a clinch and takedown threat who can drain Motta's gas tank.
Our -156 sits better than most of the market. FanDuel is at -160 to -170 and others are -165 to -180, so the number is fair to slightly generous.
research.risk: Motta has real KO power, and one early shot flips the fight while his only weakness is the cardio fade.
research.angle: Mar Fan's grappling, reach and youth against a 33-year-old Motta coming off a 17-month layoff.
context: Both fighters made weight at the UFC Qatar weigh-ins: Motta 155.5, Mar Fan 156. No injury news found.
Neutral site in Doha, so no home crowd. Mar Fan is Australian and Motta Brazilian.
Opening line was Motta +133 / Mar Fan -156, and the market has barely moved.
Motta gets more tickets and handle, but a Qatar preview noted almost no line movement.
Capper takes lean Mar Fan: ClutchPoints, BetMGM, Last Word on Sports and Doc's all pick him, mostly by decision.
